def halves(g):
 h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); nonzero_cols=[c for c in range(w) if any(g[r][c] for r in range(h))]
 gaps=[(nonzero_cols[i+1]-nonzero_cols[i]-1,nonzero_cols[i]+1) for i in range(len(nonzero_cols)-1)]
 gap,cut=max(gaps)
 # cut is first column after left occupied col
 out=[]
 for c0,c1 in [(min(nonzero_cols),cut),(cut,max(nonzero_cols)+1)]:
  pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(c0,c1) if g[r][c]]
  r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)+1
  cmin=min(c for r,c in pts); cmax=max(c for r,c in pts)+1
  out.append([[g[r][c] for c in range(cmin,cmax)] for r in range(r0,r1)])
 return gap,cut,out

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    occupied = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(h))]
    gaps = [(occupied[i + 1] - occupied[i] - 1, occupied[i]) for i in range(len(occupied) - 1)]
    _, cut = max(gaps)

    objects = []
    for lo, hi in ((0, cut + 1), (cut + 1, w)):
        points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(lo, hi) if grid[r][c] != 0]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
        r1 = max(r for r, c in points) + 1
        c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
        c1 = max(c for r, c in points) + 1
        objects.append([[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1)] for r in range(r0, r1)])

    left, right = objects
    height = max(len(left), len(right))
    width = max(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
    mismatch = []
    for r in range(height):
        row = []
        for c in range(width):
            a = left[r][c] if r < len(left) and c < len(left[0]) else 0
            b = right[r][c] if r < len(right) and c < len(right[0]) else 0
            row.append(a != b)
        mismatch.append(row)

    differing_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(mismatch) if any(row)]
    runs = []
    for r in differing_rows:
        if not runs or r > runs[-1][-1] + 1:
            runs.append([r])
        else:
            runs[-1].append(r)
    run = max(runs, key=len)
    return [[8 if mismatch[r][c] else 0 for c in range(width)] for r in range(run[0], run[-1] + 1)]
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
